correctness.rationale: Zero labels form k nonattacking rooks, in R(k)=binom(m,k)binom(n,k)k! ways. Any t of them have a union of t(m+n-t-1) nonzero neighbors; inclusion-exclusion gives exactly the displayed generating polynomial because the actual summand has z^a(z+z²)^(N-k-a)=z^(N-k)(1+z)^(N-k-a). Each defender can cover at most two zeros, giving minimum N-floor(s/2); even and odd defender pairing/path cases yield stated coefficients. At m=n=2 totality excludes precisely 4z³+2z⁴; elsewhere every positive label has a positive neighbor. Independent literal brute force verified ordinary/total counts 46/40 for (2,2), 310/310 for (2,3), and min coefficients (3,4) and (5,12). The proof, not finite counts, supports every m,n>=2.
